svg.title: Recognition and writing
svg.desc: Recognition: Silver Medal, Second rank in B.Tech CSE, SRM University Delhi-NCR, 2022–23; Star of the Month, Tata Consultancy Services, August 2025; On The Spot Award, Tata Consultancy Services, January 2026; DIAT certified, DRDO Pune. Writing and publications: The Basics of AI and IoT, A beginner’s book; ASH OS, Academic paper; Smart Industrial Robot, Registered design; 33 posts on the blog, Featured: “What I learned building AI verification pipelines” and “Building a tiny operating system to understand computers better”.
